messages.text: Morning all. Reminder that it's bins night tonight and according to the rota it is Tom's turn
The rota is a social construct
The rota is a laminated sheet on the fridge with your name on it
Bins night? More like bins MIGHT, knowing Tom
Can whoever keeps moving my monstera off the windowsill please stop, she needs her morning light 🌿
She is a living thing with feelings
I moved it to do my stretches, sorry Jess, I'll put her back after leg day
Every day is leg day with you Sam
Making a lasagne tonight for everyone, no questions, just trust the process
Is this the same process that set off the smoke alarm last Tuesday
That was a soufflé, completely different discipline
I'll bring the garlic bread, I've been carb loading anyway
Small update: the lasagne is now more of a lasagne-adjacent experience
It's giving charcoal. It's giving volcanic rock 😭
Ordering pizza, everyone send me your orders and I'll put it in the spreadsheet
Of course there's a spreadsheet
There is ALWAYS a spreadsheet
5am run done, 10k in the rain, feeling unstoppable 💪
Who is awake at 5am voluntarily, this is a cry for help
The early bird gets the gains
Also did anyone hear that noise at 3am, I'm pretty sure the flat is haunted
It sounded like someone dragging a chair across the kitchen very slowly
That was me looking for the cheese
Why does looking for cheese involve moving furniture Tom
You don't know where the cheese could be, you have to be thorough
Landlord says the boiler engineer is coming between 8am and 6pm on Thursday, very precise as always
I can work from home Thursday and let them in, my desk is basically the sofa anyway
Please nobody let him near my plants, the last guy stood on my spider plant and I still haven't recovered
Jess has more plants than the botanical gardens at this point
Thirty-four is a perfectly normal number of plants for a four bedroom flat
They're called a collection, look it up
I'm just saying there is a fern in my wardrobe and I didn't put it there
Pub quiz on Thursday at the Red Lion, who's in? I've already come up with a team name
Quiz Team Aguilera
I'm in but only if I'm allowed to do the music round, it's my time to shine
I'll do geography and history, someone needs to take this seriously
I'll be in charge of snacks and emotional support
Second place!!! Honestly so proud of us, the capital of Burkina Faso question won it
Ouagadougou. Never forget.
We would've won if someone hadn't said Beyoncé for every single music question
And I stand by every single one of those answers
Our first ever trophy, it's going on the shelf next to the plants
Has anyone seen my left trainer, I've found the right one in the freezer and I have questions
Why would it be in the freezer
That's literally what I'm asking Priya
Might have been me, I was icing my ankle last night and it was the closest thing in the dark
This flat is genuinely a sitcom
Okay serious flat meeting on Sunday about the washing up situation, attendance is mandatory
I've made an agenda and yes there are slides
Can we get snacks at the meeting if we're being held hostage
I'll bring the snacks if Priya promises the meeting is under an hour
Forty-five minutes with a five minute break for questions, I'm not a monster
Do we get a certificate for attending, asking for my CV
Okay don't be mad but I adopted a cat. She's called Pickle and she's perfect
Jess we literally have a no pets clause in the tenancy agreement
She's not a pet, she's a flatmate. She can go on the bins rota
Pickle is already more reliable on bins night than Tom
I'm being bullied in my own home
Also she is very cute, welcome to the flat Pickle
Doing a big meal prep today, who wants chicken and rice for every meal this week
I'd rather eat my trainer from the freezer
Booked the oven on the shared calendar so nobody uses it between 2 and 4
Pickle has knocked three plants off the windowsill and I've never loved anyone more
Final reminder about the flat meeting at 4, slides are ready, attendance will be taken
Can I send Pickle as my representative
Pickle is the only one who's done the washing up this week, she licked a plate
Love this flat, love you all, even Tom
